description:
Set on a sprawling, mysterious island, Luma Island blends cozy homesteading, crafting, and farming with daring exploration through ancient temples, treacherous caverns, and puzzle-filled ruins. 

Designed with player freedom in mind, Luma Island features no stamina bars or inventory restrictions, three tailored difficulty modes (Cozy, Adventure, and Hero). Luma Island invites adventurers worldwide to build their dream homestead, hatch magical companion creatures, and uncover ancient secrets together.
